theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))
